title: Attorney General files two civil False Claims Act child-nutrition suits
notes: Source-level capture from official government release on November 1, 2026. Multiple legal stages are separately described and must not be collapsed. Source status follows existing live corpus records.
supports: The AG filed civil complaints against Nasib Bakery and Abshir Hossen and separately East African Healthcare Network and related defendants on October 26.
The AG alleges false claims and improper relationships related to child-nutrition meal sites; these are civil allegations, not criminal verdicts.
The Partners in Nutrition settlement proposed September 24 is awaiting a December 15, 2026 court hearing.
The AG states the proposed Partners in Nutrition resolution is approximately $18.5 million, not confirmation of a final court-approved or independently verified collection.
does_not_support: A final judgment against the October 26 civil defendants.
Final approval of the proposed Partners in Nutrition settlement or proof of received funds.
